why: Multiple 2025 arXiv preprints claim progress on cases of the Hodge conjecture (K3 surfaces, complete intersections; a Calabi-Yau 5-fold special-case claim was later withdrawn), and there is an active, widely reported story (The Information, Gizmodo, the-decoder, etc.) of OpenAI claiming substantial internal progress on an unnamed Millennium Prize problem that multiple outlets attribute to the Hodge conjecture, followed by math-community pushback and a deleted researcher tweet.
queries: Hodge conjecture progress case solved 2025 arXiv
OpenAI Hodge conjecture tweet claim withdrawn
